FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Larchwood Liquids Pipeline Inc.
REPORTED BY
Pipeline patrol contractor
RECEIVED VIA
Email
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Subject: release near Laval
Compliance Team,
I'm emailing about a release I was told about while out patrolling the pipeline near Laval, Quebec
on May 4th around 15:00. A member of the public reported it. We're looking into it now.
From what I've gathered so far, gasoline was released and it got onto the pipeline right of way. It
also got off the right of way onto neighbouring land. I'm not sure what caused the release.
I'll keep you updated as I get more info.
Sylvain Laforest, Pipeline Patrol Contractor
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
